summary: RELX PLC filed a Form 6-K announcing a non-discretionary share buyback programme to repurchase ordinary shares between 23 July 2026 and 4 September 2026, with a spend of £150 million, following a completed £100 million programme. The programme is part of a £2.25 billion buyback plan for 2026 announced on 12 February 2026. Shares purchased will be held in treasury. ABN AMRO Bank N.V. has been appointed to manage the programme with independent trading decisions. The buyback reduces capital under existing shareholder authority. No price per share, premium, or advisor disclosed. What to watch: execution pace and market impact of ongoing repurchases; no risk-arb angle as this is an issuer buyback.
